description_sq:
Ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje pallati te ri me ashensore dhe sh mire te administruar.
Eshte i organizuar ne nje Sallon dhe kuzhine, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete, ballkon.
Disponon Certifikate pronesie dhe shitet me Kredi.
description_en: It is located on the 4th floor of a new building with an elevator and is well managed. It is organized in a living room and kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, balcony. It has ownership certificates and is sold on credit.
